distant_fp_definition: FP pixel Euclidean distance >10 native pixels from GT
limitations: The same 36-image development pool has been studied repeatedly; raw OOF is exploratory, not independent external confirmation.
Small connected components of a semantic mask are not verified individual lipid droplets.
The eight manually confirmed discovery points are excluded from method selection and from this OOF analysis.
The fold-local validation decisions are immutable inputs; outer-test results cannot revise them.
